provenanceNote: SFN 405 (4-2026). Household Member 1 maps to the applicant; Members 2-5 map to household.members[0..3]. Five employment rows plus one self-employment row map to employment.jobs[0..5]; the form's pay-frequency 'Other' has no profile equivalent. Utility Yes/No radios print No-then-Yes. Skipped as unsupported: asset screening radios and real-property detail rows (no profile fields), expedited-screening totals, pay-frequency 'Other', and signature/office-use blocks.
